body.statement: Under \(\text{ass:local-tangent-fiber-neighborhood}\), the globally completed active tangent arrangement has at least one full-dimensional strict semantic chamber.  The canonical search returns a chamber \(P_{v_*,b_*}^0\), rational \(u_*\), and rational Farkas certificates with \(\rho_0>0\).  For \(r_0=\min\{r_{\mathrm{req}},\rho_0\}\), \(\{v:u_*\in D_v^0\}=\{v_*\}\) and \(\inf_{v\ne v_*}\inf_{g\in D_v^0}\|u_*-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}\geq r_0\).  Hence \(H_{r_0}\ne\varnothing\) for \(\mathfrak G_0\) without a causal margin assumption.
body.justification: The fixed Gaussian experiment exhibits its separated point from the completed tangent geometry instead of assuming nonemptiness or evaluating an affine vector outside the simplex.
body.gap: The adjacent polyhedral and partial-identification results do not supply a scale-normalized rational distance certificate between semantic unions of local-limit cells.
body.consumer: The Job Corps encoder uses this receipt to verify the separated-domain condition for \(\mathfrak G_0\) before CertGluePFL is run.

obligation.what_is_open: Establish existence of the strict semantic chamber after the corrected cover premise is accepted.
obligation.obstruction: The rational row-separation calculation begins only after a legal full-dimensional chamber is known. That existence currently depends on the unresolved corrected global-cover proposition.
obligation.attempted: The violated-row Mahalanobis lower bound and positivity of the finite minimum were completed conditionally on a strict chamber.
obligation.partial_result:
Conditional on a strict semantic chamber and its interior point \(u_*\), every rival component has a violated row with gap \(\gamma>0\).  For every \(g\) in that component, Cauchy--Schwarz gives
\[
 \|u_*-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}
 \geq \gamma/\|A_{i\cdot}^0\|_{\Sigma_0}.
\]
The rational upper enclosure of the denominator makes the recorded \(\rho_{v,b}\) a valid lower distance, and the finite minimum is positive.  Existence of the strict legal chamber remains tied to the unresolved global-cover premise.
